data.summary:
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Certified (KPMG Sponsored) professional with 10+ years driving Process Excellence, PMO, and Digital Transformation across GCC, NBFC, and Heavy Manufacturing sectors. Proven track record of delivering USD 1.5M+ in annual savings through RPA-UiPath automation, DMAIC-led project execution, VSM, and Kaizen-based continuous improvement. Adept at leveraging Power BI, SQL, and AI-powered tools for real-time governance and data-driven decision-making across cross-functional GCC, US, and India-based teams.
I am currently pursuing my Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification from the Indian Statistical Institute (ISI).
I have personally led all 10 Green Belt projects, managing them through the project lifecycle and driving them toward successful completion.
Yes, I have managed the end-to-end Lean Six Sigma programme lifecycle across Black Belt, Green Belt, and Yellow Belt initiatives, including nominations, mobilisation, training coordination, assessments, project allocation, mentoring, certification, progress tracking, and reporting.
I have trained 100 employees in Lean Six Sigma and Continuous Improvement, comprising approximately 65 Yellow Belt and 35 Green Belt participants.
Yes. I have developed two structured training modules — ACE 1 and ACE 2 — covering Lean Six Sigma and Continuous Improvement concepts, methodologies, tools, and practical application.
I have worked across multiple process-improvement tracks, including Billing, Billing Rewrite, and other operational processes. Through process and data discovery, I identified 39 improvement opportunities. Of these, 30 were converted into automation initiatives, 6 into process-improvement initiatives, and 3 into technology-enhancement initiatives. This involved understanding the As-Is process, identifying pain points and waste, analysing root causes and data, and developing appropriate To-Be solutions.
Yes. I established and drove a Continuous Improvement culture across an organisation of approximately 1,365 employees. I introduced a biweekly Process Health Check (PHC) mechanism covering process landscapes, SOPs, Continuous Improvement trackers, employee idea submissions, FMEA, quality checks, error logs, and CAPA. This created a structured mechanism for employees to identify, track, and implement improvement opportunities across the organisation.
Approximately 30% of my role involved engagement and consulting with senior stakeholders, while 70% was focused on execution and implementation. My stakeholder responsibilities included understanding business problems, presenting data-driven findings, recommending improvement opportunities, obtaining alignment, and providing updates on the progress and impact of improvement initiatives.
KEY PROJECTS & INITIATIVES
AI-Powered Process Health Dashboard | Clean Harbors
Built a Power BI dashboard integrating RPA telemetry and SAP data for real-time process health scores across GCC departments. Reduced escalation response time by 40% and enabled proactive SLA management. Tech: Power BI, SAP, UiPath, SQL
Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) Automation | Mahindra Home Finance
Deployed enterprise IDP using UiPath + OCR to automate KYC and compliance verification. Achieved 100% regulatory compliance and cut manual verification by 70%. Impact: ₹1.5 Cr annual savings.
End-to-End Loan Process Digitization | Mahindra Home Finance
Drove full digital transformation of the loan lifecycle via RPA and workflow automation. Reduced TAT from 35 days → 7 days (80%), increased business volume by 14%, saving ₹2 Cr/year.
Enterprise Lean Transformation Roadmap | Clean Harbors GCC Designed multi-year Lean Transformation roadmap across 5 business units integrating VSM, FMEA, and Kaizen events. Delivered 20% OE improvement in Year 1 with a CI governance framework.
VoC Analytics Framework | Mahindra Home Finance Established a VoC framework using Google Analytics and NPS/CSAT data to prioritize product features. Resulted in 13.5% improvement in customer retention and 18% CSAT uplift.
CI Tracker Digitization: Excel → PowerApps | Clean Harbors
Led end-to-end digitization of CI tracker with real-time dashboards and automated alerts. Improved process visibility by 60%, reduced manual reporting by 5 hrs/week.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Clean Harbors │ Hyderabad | PMO – Global Process Excellence Manager | Dec 2025 – Present
Restored momentum on 3 stalled Green Belt projects delivering ~USD 1M in recovered annual savings, by applying structured DMAIC
re-engagement and cross-functional stakeholder realignment
Eliminated process bottlenecks in US WIN Applications Compliance Modernization achieving 35% efficiency improvement, by
conducting end-to-end VSM and SIPOC analysis across impacted workflows
Reduced operational error rates across GCC functions cutting defects by 15%, by facilitating structured RCA workshops using
Fishbone diagrams and 5-Whys methodology
Scaled automation and digital initiatives enterprise-wide saving USD 500K annually and reducing manual effort by 25%, by leading
RPA-UiPath deployments and process digitization across GCC operations
Built an organization-wide continuous improvement culture enabling 100+ employees to lead DMAIC projects with a GCC CI
governance framework, by designing and delivering LSS training covering VSM, FMEA, Kaizen, and RCA
Mahindra Home Finance │ Hyderabad | Business Excellence Manager | Aug 2023 – Nov 2025
Transformed loan processing speed end-to-end delivering 80% TAT reduction (35 → 7 days) and ₹2 Cr saved annually, by applying
DMAIC-led process redesign integrated with RPA-UiPath workflow automation
Eliminated non-value-adding steps across 5 departments driving process efficiency from 15% → 35%, by executing comprehensive
VSM to surface and remove waste at each process stage
Achieved full KYC and compliance accuracy generating 100% regulatory compliance and ₹1.5 Cr in annual savings, by deploying
Poka-Yoke driven IDP automation using UiPath and OCR — cutting manual effort by 70%
Improved complaint resolution across NHB, CPGRAMS, and NCH portals cutting closure TAT from 11.9 → 5 days (58% faster), by
applying FMEA and Control Charts for proactive SLA monitoring and risk management
Strengthened customer loyalty and satisfaction scores contributing to 13.5% retention uplift and 18% CSAT improvement, by
applying Pareto analysis and VoC (NPS/CSAT) insights to prioritize CRM product enhancements
Tata Hitachi Construction Machinery │ Pan India | Operations Excellence Manager | Jul 2019 – Jul 2023
Reduced non-turbo parts rejection rate from 15% → 5% generating ₹10 Cr in cost avoidance, by executing DMAIC projects validated
through Gauge R&R and process capability (Cpk) analysis
Lowered Hub Line consumable cost from ₹18 → ₹15.4 per part saving ₹13.2 Cr across production cycles, by applying Kaizen events
and Pareto-driven root cause elimination to target high-waste inputs
Reduced fly housing machining rejection from 0.51% → 0.10% resulting in ₹6 Cr in savings, by implementing DMAIC Control phase
with Run Charts and Statistical Process Control (SPC)
Improved production planning efficiency and inventory control achieving reduced lead time variability and lower excess stock, by
implementing JIT and Kanban systems alongside cross-functional Kaizen events mapped via SIPOC
GHH-Fahrzeuge (now Komatsu) │ India | Mechanical Engineer | Sep 2016 – Feb 2019
Maximized underground mining equipment reliability achieving 95%+ uptime and 20% reduction in unplanned downtime, by applying
5-Whys RCA for recurring failures and implementing structured preventive maintenance schedules
